note: Canonical text blocks. make_prompts.py pastes them verbatim; the validator checks that every character prompt contains STYLE exactly. Change a block only by creating stickman-v2.json, never by editing this file in place.
style: STYLE (stickman-v1): Flat 2D cartoon illustration. Every person is a clothed stick figure: a large, perfectly round, plain white head with a bold, even black outline, about one quarter of the figure's height. The face is only two small solid black vertical-oval dot eyes and one thin black line mouth, set slightly below the centre of the circle; the rest of the circle stays plain white. Short thick eyebrow strokes appear only when an expression needs them. The head sits directly on the collar with almost no neck. Arms are single thick solid black lines with crisp angular elbows, ending in small white oval mitten hands outlined in black. The body is a solid, believable, layered clothing silhouette about as wide as the head, on short legs with rounded soft shoes; standing legs are clothed trouser tubes, walking or running legs become single black stick lines that end in the same shoes. Figures are stocky, about 3.7 heads tall. Clothing and props use flat, muted, desaturated colour fills with bold black outlines, a few thin fold lines and sparse short texture tick marks. Flat colours only, with no gradients and no glossy highlights. Never add hair, a nose, ears, fingers, pupils, eye whites, skin colour, realistic anatomy, a 3D look or a photographic look.
animals: ANIMALS: animals use the same bold black outlines, flat muted fills and small solid black dot eyes as the people, with simple rounded shapes and realistic body proportions and size; fur appears only as a few short tick marks; animals never get stick limbs or white circle heads.
background_people: BACKGROUND PEOPLE: any unnamed people are the same clothed stick figures in plain muted clothes, smaller and simpler, with no accessories that belong to a named character.
setting_style: SETTING STYLE: the environment is drawn in the same flat cartoon style but quieter: slightly thinner outlines, lower contrast, muted desaturated colours, simple shapes and a few texture marks, with clear depth from foreground to background. Keep a mid-tone surface behind every white head so the heads stay readable.
sheet_background: on a flat pure white background with no scenery, no ground line, no borders, no frames and no shadows
format_scene: FORMAT: one single widescreen 16:9 landscape image. Keep every character and key object well inside the frame, away from the edges and away from the bottom-right corner.
exclusion_scene: The image contains no text at all: no letters, numbers, labels, captions, logos or speech bubbles; every paper, screen and sign is blank.
reference_guard: Do not copy the reference sheet's white background, layout, labels or poses; draw a new scene.
history_line: Make every garment, tool, object and building historically accurate for {era}; nothing anachronistic.

expressions.neutral: two dot eyes and a short flat line mouth, no eyebrows
expressions.smiling: two dot eyes and a gently upturned line mouth, no eyebrows
expressions.happy: eyes as two small upward arcs and a wide open smile
expressions.angry: two short eyebrow strokes slanting down toward the centre and a downturned mouth
expressions.sad: eyebrow strokes with raised inner ends, a downturned mouth and one small tear
expressions.worried: wavy eyebrow strokes with raised inner ends and a small wavy mouth
expressions.scared: small high arched eyebrows, dot eyes and a small open oval mouth
expressions.surprised: high round eyebrows, dot eyes and a small round O mouth
expressions.confused: one eyebrow low and flat, the other high and arched, and a wavy mouth
expressions.determined: flat eyebrow bars pressed onto the eyes and a straight firm mouth
expressions.tired: half-closed heavy-lidded eyes and a small flat mouth
expressions.laughing: eyes closed as two upward arcs and a big open grin
